lastCompletedStory.title: Raise the idle-wait deadline to a realistic named constant

nextStoryContext: sendKeysVerified's idle-gate default (src/tmux/dispatch.ts) is now the exported IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS constant (30_000 ms), replacing the inline idleTimeoutMs = 5_000 default that made the send-anyway fallback the common case for a routine long tool call (5 send-anyway warnings logged in one session per the CAM-358 filing). The idleTimeoutMs option is unchanged in shape (still caller-overridable; every existing test still injects a tiny idleTimeoutMs like 5 or 1_000 and needed no edits). isComposerEmptied, the send-keys argv shape, and SEND_KEYS_SETTLE_MS (US-001) are all untouched. The stale 'Default idleTimeoutMs is 5 000 ms' claim in scripts/cam/patterns.md (line 38, US-008 bullet) was corrected to point at the new named constant. file-size-budget.json's src/tmux/dispatch.ts ceiling was raised 348->365 (actual content.split('\n').length, one more than wc -l) with a dated _ref entry naming US-002/CAM-358. No test file changes were needed for this story: all 21 dispatch.test.ts cases and the full 5146-test suite passed unchanged.
